principle: Increase useful diversity by composing and sampling simple rules. Keep the frontend/tensor meaning stable.
evidence_level: Implementation audit and research judgment; no new empirical or biological validity claims.

axes.current: Seven families; fresh graph, memory, coupling, mode or local parameters within existing priors.
axes.unexplored: Broader graph motifs, modularity, non-normal linear dynamics, state-dependent couplings. E/I feedback coefficients and several dimensions remain fixed.
axes.priority: Later; add only if a learning/control result motivates it.

axes.current: Native stochastic drives or whole public read-speech utterances; speaker/chapter/utterance order sampled, literal phone timing retained.
axes.unexplored: Dialogue, spontaneous speech, different languages, separate perception/production phases, task trial hierarchy and long contextual dependencies.
axes.priority: High scientific gap; random phone vectors do not emulate speech semantics.

axes.current: Sustained, onset, causal overlap; one30–150ms timescale per recording.
axes.unexplored: Input strength, multiple timescales, anticipation, causal delays, population-specific latency, refractory or saturating inputs, slower word/syllable envelopes.
axes.priority: Next compact extension if current inputs matter to transfer. Do not add all at once.

axes.current: Independent phone patterns or four random shared factors plus independent detail; persistent16D master input and family-appropriate projection.
axes.unexplored: Measured/articulatory phone relationships, context-dependent phone mappings, sparse versus distributed input sites, input rank and strength.
axes.priority: High uncertainty; current shared factors are random, not articulatory truth.

axes.current: Original family-specific recurrence, switching, propagation, oscillation and timescale priors.
axes.unexplored: Common behavioral characterization across families; extended hierarchy, plasticity, delayed interactions, multi-area coupling.
axes.priority: First assess effective responses, not just coefficient counts.

axes.current: States evolve; network/input mapping/renderer stay fixed throughout each recording.
axes.unexplored: Slow arousal/session drift, changing gain/noise, fatigue, habituation, event-dependent adaptation beyond the E/I rule.
axes.priority: Plausible next recording-level axis; preserve temporal coherence.

axes.current: Independent fresh worlds; paired same-source observation controls remain available for inspection.
axes.unexplored: Multiple sessions sharing a persistent subject/network/map but with new recording conditions; calibrated correlated priors.
axes.priority: Useful for invariance tests; not automatically learned by MAE.

axes.current: Random integer H8–24 and W8–34, up to512contacts, plain rectangles fixed per recording over24×34sourcefield. Existing reference masks remain an explicit option; no frequency matching or held-template blacklist.
axes.unexplored: Physical electrode pitch, cortical folding/geodesic distance, anatomical coverage, hardware-specific transfer functions and simultaneous arrays.
axes.priority: Tile geometry is not physical geometry. Do not claim hardware realism.

axes.current: One broadband voltage renderer; frequency-dependent mixing; all20bins; HGA mixing0.65 and shared HGA factor off under the adopted recipe.
axes.unexplored: Broader validated spectral/cross-bin covariance and coherence priors, non-Gaussian or correlated innovations, subject-specific HGA dynamics.
axes.priority: Retain current measured constraints; do not widen every parameter independently.

axes.current: Existing stationary added voltage noise, contact sensitivity and observation variation.
axes.unexplored: Bad/missing contacts, intermittent artifacts, line noise, reference changes, filtering/hardware differences, nonstationary interference.
axes.priority: Separate controlled nuisances from the clean dynamics distribution; actual current availability is all-true.

axes.current: Explicit native/speech counts and geometry set; base conditional family weights preserved; no hidden real/synthetic ratio.
axes.unexplored: Optimal mixture weights, difficulty curriculum, post-normalization diversity, actual patch exposure versus world counts.
axes.priority: Measure in the first learning experiment; visual diversity is not the target metric.

axes.current: Mechanical packet/input qualifications and native controls; no training in this work.
axes.unexplored: Does coordinated synthetic activity improve held-out-subject performance beyond real-only SSL and smoothing/statistical controls?
axes.priority: Decisive next experiment with the pretraining owner after Ben releases the held handoff.

remaining_fixed_choices.fixed: 16master coordinates; phone-vector SD0.8; shared rank4 and50%variance; three shapes; tau30–150ms; fixed coupling normalization and EI gain3.125.
remaining_fixed_choices.implication: Input strength and organization cover a narrower prior than the family catalogue suggests. Linear family input changes can be weak.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: Highest-priority candidate is one sampled input-strength scale, with timing range reviewed together. Not silently added in this release.

remaining_fixed_choices.fixed: Linear16D/symmetric OU/Gaussian innovations; rSLDS16D/four modes/stay-next structure; E/I three states with fixed feedback weights and spatial kernels.
remaining_fixed_choices.implication: Fresh seeds vary many actual coefficients, but do not explore every network structure or stochastic process.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: Keep these simple comparators. New graph motifs or dimensions are optional future prior changes, not required new family names.

remaining_fixed_choices.fixed: One read-speech speaker/chapter per world; random phone vectors/shared features; no explicit word/syllable or listening/production state driver; literal acoustic timing without fitted neural delays.
remaining_fixed_choices.implication: Sequence organization is real; neural/phonetic correspondence is speculative.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: A small hierarchical or delayed input extension is a separate test; no articulation/semantic claims.

remaining_fixed_choices.fixed: Maps/network/observation fixed within64s; stationary added-noise family; all scalar availability true; no hardware/QC dropouts.
remaining_fixed_choices.implication: Within-recording drift and nuisance variation are narrower than real recordings.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: Potential shared gain/noise drift or availability masks can be simple, but preserve current clean-data control.

remaining_fixed_choices.fixed: One broadband voltage construction, five source projections, fixed HGA mixing0.65 and shared HGA factor0; finite spectral/spatial parameter ranges.
remaining_fixed_choices.implication: All cores are observed through one class of measurement process. Broader renderer diversity remains untested.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: Preserve the qualified renderer for the first learning comparison; do not add special cases for every mismatch.

remaining_fixed_choices.fixed: Conditional family mass oscillator1/4, others1/8; six speech profiles in complete balanced blocks.
remaining_fixed_choices.implication: Diversity is present, but exposure weights are an inherited design choice, not optimized or physiologically measured.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: Native/speech counts and real/synthetic mass remain explicit owner decisions.

remaining_fixed_choices.implication: Finite engineering bounds, not a claim that neural recordings require these dimensions/durations.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: Broaden if the actual target needs it; avoid an unlimited geometry prior.

remaining_fixed_choices.fixed: Physical frequency bins, CAR/filter/STFT definitions, feature axes, normalization recipe and split/identity checks.
remaining_fixed_choices.implication: These define what a model input means; randomizing them indiscriminately would mix incompatible inputs.
remaining_fixed_choices.next: Variation belongs upstream in activity/observation, with any frontend change separately declared.

effective_input_difference_evidence.metric: RMS difference of quantized normalized HGA band means versus sustained-independent on the same world and grid; one world/family, not transfer/SNR/population proof.
